simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶרְאֵל (H691) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֶרְאֵל (ʼerʼêl) means a hero (collectively) First listed occurrence: Isa 33 7.

definitions.full: H691. erel [ אֶרְאֵל ] noun [masculine] (form & meaning dubious see below) — only in אֶרְאֶלָּם Isa 33:7 ; Ges אַרְאֵלִם heroes ; compare Thes Kn Che; Hi אֲרִאֵלָם ; compare De, who derives from אֲרִיאֵל , literally = lion of God , collective with suffix, & translated their heroes ; name, of a people from אֲרִיאֵל = Zion Nbr Ath. 1886, p. 400 compare Say ib. 466 ; Ew אַרְאָל = אַרְעָל trembling , compare Di. Brd proposes הילילו 'cry pitifully.' ᵑ9 ᵑ6 and others read some form of ירא ᵐ5 ראה, . Wholly uncertain. II. ארה ( burn , compare Arabic , whence hearth ; Ew § 163 g and others see below)
